pocketbrowser.title: Pocket Browser
pocketbrowser.error.launch: The browser could not be started
pocketbrowser.error.lost: The connection to the browser was lost
pocketbrowser.error.signin_busy: The browser has not finished closing yet
pocketbrowser.error.signin_busy.hint: The sign-in window opened inside the invisible one because the profile is still in use. Wait a few seconds and choose "Sign in to an account..." again.
pocketbrowser.error.hint: Pocket Browser drives a copy of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi or Chromium that is already on this computer. Install one of them, or set browserPath in config/pocketbrowser.json.
pocketbrowser.signin.waiting: A sign-in window is already open
pocketbrowser.signin.hint: If you are already signed in, just close that window. If not, sign in and close it, and the browser will come back with the session kept.
pocketbrowser.settings.title: Pocket Browser settings
pocketbrowser.settings.quality.tip: The higher, the sharper the text.
pocketbrowser.settings.format.tip: Perfect text, noticeably slower on every frame, not suited to video.
pocketbrowser.settings.fps.tip: Frames per second ceiling. Caps what a video can cost the game.
pocketbrowser.settings.still.tip: The moment the page stops moving, the frame is replaced by an uncompressed one - pixel for pixel what the browser draws, text antialiasing included.
pocketbrowser.settings.video_quality.tip: Ask the player for the highest quality that fits the frame.
pocketbrowser.settings.real_window.tip: Drops the HeadlessChrome token from the User-Agent.
pocketbrowser.settings.restore.tip: Open the browser on the page you left it on.
pocketbrowser.settings.theme.tip: Styling for the browser window and the mini window.
pocketbrowser.settings.pin_dim.tip: Dim the mini window until you take control of it.
pocketbrowser.settings.pin_opacity.tip: Transparency of the mini window, page included.
pocketbrowser.settings.pin_hide: Hide the pinned window with F1
pocketbrowser.preset.performance.hint: Frame no wider than 960, 24 per second. The lightest row.
pocketbrowser.preset.balanced.hint: 30 frames per second at full screen size. Suits everything.
pocketbrowser.preset.sharp.hint: Full size and the least compression, paid for at 20 frames per second. For reading.
pocketbrowser.preset.fluid.hint: 60 frames per second at a frame width of 1280. For video and fast scrolling.
pocketbrowser.preset.lossless.hint: Pixel for pixel what the browser draws, in motion too, at 15 frames per second.
pocketbrowser.pin.title: Pinned browser
pocketbrowser.pin.controls: Drag the title bar to move it; the corner to resize it.
key.pocketbrowser.pin: Pin or unpin the mini window
